metadata.title: Three-mode Gaussian preparation, heralded Fock processing, and interferometric readout
metadata.notes: Prepares a three-mode Gaussian state, independently explores an even cat through heralded photon subtraction and addition, scans a lossy Mach-Zehnder interferometer, and compares homodyne with heterodyne conditioning of the Gaussian signal mode.

execution_stages.title: Gaussian preparation
execution_stages.description: Run the three-mode Gaussian circuit and obtain its final state.
execution_stages.inspect: Check the signal phase-space geometry after the recorded circuit execution.
execution_stages.insight: The phase-space ellipse is the state's uncertainty region before anything non-Gaussian happens to it.

execution_stages.title: Covariance structure
execution_stages.description: Inspect the second-order moments of the final Gaussian circuit state.
execution_stages.inspect: Look for squeezing, variances, and cross-mode covariance structure.
execution_stages.insight: The diagonal reads as single-mode variances; the off-diagonal blocks are the inter-mode covariance the later conditioned measurements draw on.

execution_stages.title: Mode correlations
execution_stages.description: Visualize the correlations established between signal, idler, and reference.
execution_stages.inspect: Use this as the correlation baseline for the homodyne/heterodyne comparison later.
execution_stages.insight: Correlated quadratures here are exactly what the later conditioned measurements exploit.

execution_stages.title: Even cat preparation
execution_stages.description: Construct the even Schrödinger cat in the truncated Fock basis.
execution_stages.inspect: Look for the non-Gaussian two-lobed structure and interference fringes.
execution_stages.insight: A two-lobed Wigner function with interference fringes is the signature a Gaussian description cannot produce.

execution_stages.title: Cat-state diagnostics
execution_stages.description: Inspect the prepared cat in the complementary state representations.
execution_stages.inspect: Compare occupation structure and phase-space features before heralding.
execution_stages.insight: Occupation structure in Fock space is the complementary view of the same non-Gaussian state the Wigner function shows.

execution_stages.title: Photon subtraction
execution_stages.description: Apply realistic heralded photon subtraction to the cat state.
execution_stages.inspect: Compare the conditioned state with the input cat and account for finite detector efficiency.
execution_stages.insight: Finite tap reflectivity and detector efficiency make this a realistic conditional operation, not an ideal one.

execution_stages.title: Photon addition
execution_stages.description: Apply realistic heralded photon addition to the subtraction output.
execution_stages.inspect: Compare against subtraction to see the effect of conditional photon-number engineering.
execution_stages.insight: Compare directly against subtraction to see how heralded photon-number engineering reshapes the state.

execution_stages.title: Mach–Zehnder scan
execution_stages.description: Scan the processed Fock state through the lossy Mach–Zehnder interferometer.
execution_stages.inspect: Follow the phase-dependent output response across all 33 scan points.
execution_stages.insight: The phase scan is the bridge from state preparation to a readout that depends on interferometer phase.

execution_stages.title: Homodyne readout
execution_stages.description: Condition the Gaussian state on the measured signal quadrature.
execution_stages.inspect: Inspect the remaining idler state after selecting one quadrature outcome.
execution_stages.insight: Homodyne selects one quadrature; the conditioned idler state reflects only that partial information.

execution_stages.title: Heterodyne readout
execution_stages.description: Condition the Gaussian state on simultaneous x/p detection.
execution_stages.inspect: Inspect the conditioned state after a two-quadrature measurement outcome.
execution_stages.insight: Heterodyne samples both quadratures at once, trading precision for a genuinely two-dimensional outcome.

execution_stages.title: Measurement comparison
execution_stages.description: Compare the conditioned states produced by homodyne and heterodyne readout.
execution_stages.inspect: Compare how the measurement model changes the inferred idler state.
execution_stages.insight: Same input state, two measurement models -- the difference is what each scheme lets you infer.
